name: RC-B10-0520/2026 – Recital C – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting EU cities’ candidacies to host a new United Nations pillar for the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI
part_text: C. whereas the EU benefits from a strong and diverse ecosystem of research, innovation and technological expertise, and public and private actors across the EU are increasingly collaborating to contribute to the responsible development, independent assessment and ethical governance of AI, including human control, democratic oversight and accountability; whereas, since July 2026, businesses, academia and civil society organisations in Milan have put forward concrete proposals to host, within the EU, UN functions dedicated to the independent assessment and ethical governance of AI;
